name: African Elephant
behavior: Lives in family herds led by an older female. Best seen at waterholes in the dry season.

name: Lion
behavior: Lives in prides and hunts mostly at dawn, dusk and night. Often resting in shade by day.

name: Leopard
habitat: Woodland, rocky hills and riverine forest
behavior: Solitary and nocturnal. Look for it resting in trees along rivers.

name: Cape Buffalo
behavior: Moves in large herds and can be dangerous when alone or wounded.

name: Black Rhino
behavior: Shy and solitary. Most active early morning and late afternoon.

name: White Rhino
behavior: Grazer that lives in small groups. Calmer than the black rhino.

name: Cheetah
behavior: Hunts by day using speed. Often scans the plains from termite mounds.

name: African Wild Dog
behavior: Hunts in cooperative packs and travels over very large areas.

name: Plains Zebra
behavior: Lives in family groups and often mixes with wildebeest herds.

name: Blue Wildebeest
behavior: Migrates in huge herds following the rains.

name: Impala
behavior: Very alert and leaps to escape predators. Common in most reserves.

name: Giraffe
behavior: Browses on acacia leaves and is easy to spot above the treeline.

name: African Fish Eagle
behavior: Perches over water and is known for its loud, ringing call.

name: Lilac-breasted Roller
behavior: Perches on exposed branches and dives to catch insects.

name: Secretarybird
behavior: Walks long distances on the ground and stamps on snakes and small prey.

name: Ostrich
behavior: World's largest bird. Cannot fly but runs at high speed.
